spoken_script: US-Europe AI investment gap widens. Oxford Economics projects US corporate spending on equipment and facilities will rise 40% between 2021 and 2027, compared to 12% in the Eurozone. This growth is primarily driven by massive AI data center investments from major US tech firms. Why it matters: The disparity suggests a potential long-term productivity and infrastructure advantage for the US, as European markets struggle to match the scale of AI-focused capital expenditure.
